button.label: Trade Assistant
button.supertip: Open the state-aware control panel for processing, unknowns, scenarios, buy plans, email, and settings.

button.label: Process Holdings
button.supertip: Preview and rebuild the active raw CDS export into the standard holdings report.

button.label: Save Unknowns
button.supertip: Validate every unknown ticker class, save the mappings, clear the review box, and refresh the report.

button.label: Plan Sells
button.supertip: Preview and create the proposed sell workbench: one target raise amount, Pool/Manual/Exclude row choices, and live S2 proposed allocation.

button.label: Add Scenarios
button.supertip: Preview and add S1 pro-rata raise-cash scenario plus the scenario summary.

button.label: Spawn Scenario
button.supertip: Preview and add the next manual scenario block for custom sells.

button.label: Remove Scenario
button.supertip: Preview, prompt for the scenario number, remove it, and renumber remaining scenarios.

button.label: Add Buy Plans
button.screentip: Add or refresh scenario buy plans
button.supertip: Preview and add buy-plan areas while preserving existing ticker and amount inputs.

button.label: Cash-Only Plan
button.supertip: Preview and create a separate Cash Buy Plan worksheet without touching scenarios.

button.label: Generate Email
button.supertip: Preview and validate scenario trades, then show the confirmation before Outlook is used.

button.label: Open Settings
button.supertip: Open the settings sheet for ticker mappings and defaults.

button.label: Close Settings
button.supertip: Hide settings, refresh mappings, and save the macro workbook.
